digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration and developer gates
propositions: Local developer gates must resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles and execute end-to-end without fallback to direct Anthropic API calls
Prompt caching must actively engage on the Bedrock path, evidenced by nonzero cache_read_tokens across multiple gate runs, not write-only behavior
All three local gates (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) must return parseable, structured verdicts when executed against Bedrock without provider-shaped degradation
Configuration must be layered and reversible via environment variable, allowing a developer to switch between Bedrock and Anthropic in one step
Bedrock cachePoint TTL behavior must be documented and compared against Anthropic cache_control defaults to establish whether observable differences exist
